name: bigbuy-mcp
description: BigBuy (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order, track. Every

platform_mcp_bigbuy_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_bigbuy_api_key.description: BigBuy API key from the control panel (API access is part of BigBuy's paid packs), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (JWT bearer scheme in the OpenAPI spec). Sandbox keys need base https://api.sandbox.bigbuy.eu, which this server does not switch to.

platform_mcp_bigbuy_iso_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_ISO_CODE
platform_mcp_bigbuy_iso_code.description: Two-letter language for product texts and tracking descriptions (the `isoCode` query parameter, e.g. en); BigBuy defaults to es when unset.

platform_mcp_bigbuy_payment_method.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_PAYMENT_METHOD
platform_mcp_bigbuy_payment_method.description: paymentMethod for create_order: paypal, moneybox (prepaid purse, see GET /rest/user/purse) or bankwire; left out of the body when unset.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /rest/user/auth/status.json answers {code: 200, message} when the key is valid (rate limit 1 request/s).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /rest/catalog/productsinformation.json (per-language product texts: [{id, sku, name, description, url, isoCode}]); pages are 0-based (`page`, `pageSize`), `category` is the parentTaxonomy tree id and `query` is not accepted by the endpoint. Rate limit 24 requests/hour. Prices come from GET /rest/catalog/productprices.json and stock from /rest/catalog/productsstockbyhandlingdays.json (not mapped); `url` is the product slug, not an absolute link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /rest/catalog/productinformation/{id}.json: {id, sku, name, description, url, isoCode} (rate limit 1 request/5 s). Wholesale/retail prices are in GET /rest/catalog/product/{id}.json and stock by handling days in GET /rest/catalog/productstockbyhandlingdays/{id}.json (not mapped).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /rest/order/create.json submits a real order (201 -> {order_id}) and charges the account (paymentMethod from the payment_method setting: paypal, moneybox or bankwire). `shipping_address` is BigBuy's shippingAddress {firstName, lastName, country (ISO-2), postcode, town, address, phone, email, vatNumber, companyName, comment}; `items` are products [{reference (SKU, e.g. S12435678), quantity}]. `shipping_option` is not sent: BigBuy's carriers[{name}] list cannot be built from a string, so the platform picks the carrier. Simulate first with POST /rest/order/check.json (not mapped).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /rest/order/{orderId}.json: {id, internalReference, dateAdd, totalPaidTaxIncl, totalPaidTaxExcl, totalShippingTaxIncl, status, carriers[{id, name, price}], shippingAddress, products[{id, reference, quantity, name, priceTaxIncl}]}. Amounts are EUR; tracking numbers come from the track tool.

tools.name: track
tools.description: GET /rest/tracking/order/{idOrder}.json returns [{id, reference, trackings[{trackingNumber, statusDescription, statusDate, carrier{id}, descriptionTranslated}]}]; the events are the trackings of the first (only) order element. Answers 404 while no tracking exists yet.
